strain: Flinders Sensitive Line (FSL) and Flinders Resistant Line (FRL)

sex.evidence: Male Flinders Line rats (FSL and FRL; see Table 1 for age and weight)

dosing.evidence: Saline, psilocin, or psilocybin was injected intraperitoneally at a volume of 1 ml... The following doses were used: psilocin 0.50 and 2.0 mg/kg
psilocybin 2.0, 3.0, and 10 mg/kg, as summarised in Table 1. E3: 3 (1 per day for 3 days); E2 and E4: single administration

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described in methods.

group_housing.evidence: were housed in pairs (Cage 1291H Eurostandard Type III H...)

day_night_flipped.evidence: on a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 07:00 a.m.)

assays.assay_description: 5-min OFT in 100×100×30 cm black plastic arena; total distance travelled tracked via infrared camera and EthoVision XT 12. Conducted across 4 experiments (E1-E4) with varying doses of psilocin/psilocybin and varying intervals between last injection and test (4 h, 24 h, or 8 days).

application_type.evidence: Saline, psilocin, or psilocybin was injected intraperitoneally at a volume of 1 ml

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were placed in the middle of a novel arena... and left for 5 min

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed in the middle of a novel arena... and left for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food in OFT apparatus during 5 min test; ad libitum food in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: No water in OFT apparatus during 5 min test

time_to_assay.evidence: Time between (last) injection and tests: E1: 24 h, E2: 24 h, E3: 8 days, E4: 4 h

sample_size.evidence: Figure 1 legend: E1 n=8/group; E2 n=7-8/group; E3 n=7-8/group (one died); E4 n=8-10/group

outcomes.summary: Psilocin and psilocybin had no statistically significant effect on locomotor activity (total distance travelled) in the OFT across all four experiments at any dose or timepoint. FSL rats showed higher locomotor activity than FRL rats.
outcomes.evidence: Treatment with psilocin or psilocybin had no statistically significant effect on locomotor activity in the OFT in any of the experiments

B1_num_measures.evidence: the total distance travelled within 5 min was quantified

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single total distance over 5 min session

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested alone in the arena.

B6_cognitive.evidence: OFT measures innate locomotion; no learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: quantified using Ethovision XT 12 video tracking software (position tracking only)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Two-way ANOVA only; no multivariate analysis.

E2_shelter.evidence: Open arena with no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: Bare plastic floor; cleaned with 70% ethanol between sessions.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in OFT apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in OFT apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single arena with no physical dividers.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in OFT apparatus during 5 min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each animal performed one 5-min OFT trial.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each animal performed a single OFT session in its assigned experiment.

D5_followup.evidence: E1/E2: 24 h post-injection; E3: 8 days post-injection (last dose); E4: 4 h

assays.assay_description: Modified FST (no pre-swim session) in Plexiglas cylinders (60 cm tall, 20 cm diameter, 40 cm water at 24±2°C) for 5 min. Immobility, swimming, and struggling scored every 5 s by a blinded trained observer. Conducted across 4 experiments (E1-E4) testing psilocin (0.5, 2 mg/kg) and psilocybin (2, 3×3, 10 mg/kg) at 4 h, 24 h, or 8 days after last injection.

application_type.evidence: Saline, psilocin, or psilocybin was injected intraperitoneally at a volume of 1 ml

setup_habituation.evidence: A modified FST was applied with no pre-swim session

setup_restrain.evidence: Plexiglas cylinders 60 cm tall, 20 cm in diameter, filled with 40 cm water — FST cylinder counts as restraint per rubric.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in FST apparatus during 5 min test.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible during the 5-min swim test.

time_to_assay.evidence: Time between (last) injection and tests: E1: 24 h, E2: 24 h, E3: 8 days, E4: 4 h

sample_size.evidence: Figure 2 legend: E1 n=8/group; E2 n=6-8/group (1 outlier excluded); E3 n=7-8/group; E4 n=8-10/group

outcomes.summary: Psilocin and psilocybin showed no effect on immobility, swimming, or struggling behaviour in the FST across all four experiments, at any dose or timepoint. FSL rats showed significantly higher immobility than FRL rats, confirming the depressive-like phenotype, but psychedelic treatment did not reduce it.
outcomes.evidence: Treatment with psilocin or psilocybin had no statistically significant effect on immobility time in any of the experiments

B1_num_measures.evidence: Each video was scored for immobility, swimming, and struggling behaviour

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Behaviours determined every 5 s but reported as a single total over 5 min; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swimming/struggling are not natural ethological behaviours per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored... by a single, trained observer

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate univariate two-way ANOVAs for each behaviour.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Plexiglas cylinders 60 cm tall, 20 cm in diameter

E2_shelter.evidence: Open cylinder with water; no refuge.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat tested alone in the cylinder.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinking water accessible during 5 min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each animal performed one 5-min FST trial; modified FST with no pre-swim session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: rats were subjected to the FST for 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single FST session per animal in each experiment.

D4_baseline.evidence: A modified FST was applied with no pre-swim session

D5_followup.evidence: E1/E2: 24 h post-injection; E3: 8 days post-last injection

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same two assays (OFT and FST). Merged across the 4 experiments (E1-E4) per rubric: same paradigm under different doses/timepoints = one assay.

D1_continuity scored 0 (Single session): each animal underwent a single OFT and single FST trial; the 4 experiments used different cohorts of animals, not repeated sessions on the same animals. Corrected qwen's '1' to '0'.
D3_recording_days scored 0 (1): each animal has 1 recording day for each assay; the 4 experiments are different cohorts. Corrected qwen and gptoss who counted across experiments.
B1 for FST scored 1 (2-3 measures: immobility, swimming, struggling), correcting gptoss who put '4-6'.
setup_restrain for FST scored 'yes' per rubric (FST cylinder explicitly listed as restraint).
time_to_assay set to 'multiple' since the same assay was tested at distinct timepoints (4 h, 24 h, 8 days) across experiments.
Psilocybin schedule marked 'multiple' since both single (E2, E4) and repeated (E3, 3 days) dosing were used.
